metadata.title: Linear B Master Lexicon — Unicode Syllabary + LS Enhanced Resolutions
metadata.unicode_scope: Linear B Syllabary block U+10000–U+1007F only; Linear B Ideograms U+10080–U+100FF intentionally not merged in this syllabary/sign pass.

font_check.usage: Used locally only to verify cmap/codepoint coverage; font file is not embedded or redistributed.

merge_policy.standard_layer: Unicode character name and codepoint are kept as the stable machine-readable base.
merge_policy.enhancement_layer: The Operator/LS 11-sign resolutions are preserved under ls_enhanced_resolution without deleting standard Unicode values.
merge_policy.conflict_handling: If an LS resolution differs from a standard Unicode syllabic transliteration, both are retained and a merge_note is added.
merge_policy.unencoded_sign_handling: If a sign is not Unicode encoded, the entry is preserved with symbol:null plus rendering hints rather than fabricating a codepoint.
